title: Commerce AI is fragmenting. Here is why that matters.
summary: The hallucination problem in commerce AI is largely a data coherence problem in disguise. The fragmented approach to commerce AI creates a specific kind of reporting problem: individual tools perform well in isolation while the system underperforms in aggregate.
